item.title: Le Grand rassemblement — 6th Edition
item.description: Come celebrate the 6th edition of this end-of-summer festival in one of the most beautiful spots in the Îles-de-la-Madeleine! Nestled between sea and cliffs, Anse aux Baleiniers opens its arms for a vibrant, festive celebration deeply rooted in Madelinot soul. Whether you’re a longtime islander or passing visitor, this festival is an invitation to fully experience the spirit of the Îles: the sea, the music, the laughter and unforgettable encounters. Don’t miss this final festive stop before autumn arrives!

item.title: Akadie 2000 Reunion Show
item.description: Come celebrate the richness and warmth of Acadian culture at our show in Fatima! This festive event honours music, dance, gastronomy and the traditions of the Acadian people, whose history is intimately tied to that of the Îles-de-la-Madeleine. Whether you’re Acadian or simply curious, come experience a colourful evening filled with infectious rhythms, regional flavours and warm encounters!

item.title: Little Whale Festival
item.description: Children and adults alike, get ready for a magical day filled with play, laughter, and creativity! The Children’s Festival, for its first edition, offers activities and surprises to discover! Throughout the day, enjoy continuous entertainment, interactive and creative games, and challenges of skill and dexterity. Also, be sure to meet our mascot, always ready to make children laugh and dance! Come and experience a day of family fun, with your feet in the sand and your head full of unforgettable memories. Bring your smile, your energy, and your sunscreen!

item.title: Sécuri-Fête — Canadian Snowbirds
item.description: On June 27 and 28, 2026, don’t miss two spectacular days of safety demonstrations and airshows featuring the legendary Canadian Forces Snowbirds! Watch these elite pilots perform breathtaking aerial maneuvers, showcasing extraordinary teamwork, discipline and skill. A must-see for aviation enthusiasts, families and anyone who admires Canadian excellence! 🚐 RVs and campervans are not permitted on site.

item.title: Fête nationale Show in Fatima
item.description: Join us for a festive and heartwarming evening where music, good vibes, and local pride will be celebrated! On stage, discover a lineup of local artists who will have you singing, dancing, and grooving to the rhythm of our greatest hits from yesterday and today. Bring your chair, your flag, and your biggest smile… and come experience a moment of pride, togetherness, and fun under the stars!
